_comment: category -> energy level. Replaces the old per-task Ollama energy call (see utils/label.txt) with a static lookup keyed on the category Ollama already assigns. Every communication-mechanism category (mail, message, call, linkedin) is low by policy. The rest follow the same reasoning the old energy prompt used per category: deep_computer/deep_offline are high (sustained generative work); admin_desk/admin_mobile, read_mobile, physical_home/physical_out are low (rote, passive, or physical-only); read_desk and the ambiguous job/unknown buckets are medium.
